messages:
Nina (CSM): FYI Portside Shipping (org_ps_212) just spun up 3 new product squads and flipped on embeddings + rerank for cargo-matching. They reported a sudden QPS bump from ~80 -> ~300 and some failed requests during peak. Can infra look?

Dave (AM): This smells like an upsell opportunity if we can stabilize. Renewal in ~4 months. I'll prep AE talk track but need a reliability signal first.

Rohit (Infra): Can you share a sample request distribution? batch sizes, seq lengths, peak window? We can temp-reserve additional capacity and enable route-level caching.

Nina (CSM): They said batch=16 for embeddings, mostly 64-512 token summaries for rerank. Peak window 09:30-11:30 UTC. Org: org_ps_212. Errors look like 503s and elevated p99.

Kai (Support): I'll open ticket CS-9988 and grab logs. Scheduling an enablement call with their infra + PM tomorrow 10am PT to walk batching and prompt best-practices. Add meeting invite?

usage-bot: Detected anomaly for org_ps_212: 3.7x baseline over 2h. Recommended actions: temporary reservation, enable prefix/KV cache on /v1/embeddings, consider switching to quantized embedder.

Rohit (Infra): Quick plan: 1) run `rb prov estimate --org org_ps_212 --lookback 6h` 2) if numbers fit, run `rb reserve --org org_ps_212 --pods 3 --profile dedicated-small --duration 72h` 3) flip on per-route cache TTL=60s for rerank. I'll post estimates here in 20m.

Dave (AM): Matt (AE) @Matt - can you be ready to discuss a 6mo reserved pilot if they like Dedicated? Also flag that they process invoice attachments (PII) so Private or dedicated with KMS might be needed.

Nina (CSM): Adding product ask: any quick batching config we can recommend for 64-512 token seq to reduce p95?

Rohit (Infra): Recommend batching target=32 for embeddings, max latency budget 250ms. Also suggest embedding quant-profile medium. Will attach numbers to CS-9988.

Kai (Support): Post-call checklist added to CS-9988: onboarding blockers, prompt patterns, auth anomalies, KMS requirements. Follow-up check in 7 days after enablement.

Nina (CSM): Great. Next steps: Rohit posts prov numbers, I run the enablement tomorrow, Dave/AEs prep upsell if performance stabilizes. I'll capture notes in renewal tracker and add expansion signal tag.

Rohit (Infra): Prov estimate done - 72h burst with 3 pods keeps p95 within SLO for peak window. Queuing reservation once Nina confirms. Numbers posted to ticket.

Nina (CSM): ✅ Confirming reservation. I'll run the enablement and share customer feedback. Thanks team!
